consequence.statement: Write load across ingesters will be automatically balanced using stream sharding by default, potentially redistributing traffic patterns across ingester instances.

original.statement: Automatic stream sharding is enabled by default in Loki 3.0.0 to balance write load across ingesters and avoid hot-spotting.

decision.reason: [ev-ed0515bb7146] says only that automatic stream sharding is now on by default to balance write load of high-volume streams across ingesters and avoid hot-spotting. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. A new default that keeps working is behavior-change, which is a review item. The proposed statement stays within what the evidence says, and the "potentially redistributing" part is clearly hedged. The evidence does not settle severity; medium is a reasonable judgment call.
